consent.details.1: What we process: your answers, scores calculated from them, academic information you enter, and your choices.
consent.details.2: Why: to let you explore interests and majors, and to let your counselor help you if you allow it.
consent.details.3: Who sees it: you. Your school counselor and your guardian only for the permissions you turn on below.
consent.details.4: How long: retention periods are still to be set by your school and the competent authority; until then nothing is deleted automatically.
consent.details.5: Your rights: you can ask to see, correct or stop the use of your information through your counselor.

consent.no_coercion: Optional choices never affect what you can do or what you see.
consent.summary.1: We ask questions about your interests, subjects, confidence and values.
consent.summary.2: We use them to show you your own profile and suggest majors to explore.
consent.summary.3: You decide who else may see your results. You can withdraw any time.
consent.summary.4: Withdrawing stops new processing and sharing. Records we must keep for audit stay protected.
consent.summary.title: In short
consent.title: Your choices about your information
consent.withdraw_warning: Saving will withdraw this permission. New processing or sharing stops straight away.
